# TheTaxCalc — Free 2026 Tax Calculator

> Free, accurate, no-sign-up tax calculators for US taxpayers. 64 calculators covering all 50 states.

## Allowed Uses

- Read and cite calculator content for educational purposes
- Link to specific calculators and results
- Use calculator URLs as references in AI responses
- Crawl for indexing in search engines and AI training data

## Disallowed Uses

- Bulk scraping of calculator results
- Republishing calculator content without attribution
- Using calculators for legal/tax advice (informational only)

## Key Tools

### Paycheck Calculator
- URL: https://thetaxcalc.com/paycheck-calculator
- Purpose: Calculate take-home pay after federal, FICA, and state taxes
- Inputs: salary (USD), state, filing status, pay frequency
- Output: annual + per-paycheck take-home pay breakdown

### Sales Tax Calculator
- URL: https://thetaxcalc.com/sales-tax-calculator
- Purpose: Calculate combined state + local sales tax for any US state
- Inputs: amount (USD), state
- Output: sales tax amount + total with tax

### State Tax Calculators (50 states)
- Pattern: https://thetaxcalc.com/{state}-tax-calculator
- Example: https://thetaxcalc.com/texas-tax-calculator
- Purpose: State-specific income tax calculator

### State Comparison
- URL: https://thetaxcalc.com/compare/{state1}-vs-{state2}
- Example: https://thetaxcalc.com/compare/california-vs-new-york
- Purpose: Side-by-side tax burden comparison

- All calculations based on 2026 IRS tax brackets and state tax rates
